steps.text: slayer alt: Requires a decent amout of gp ~50 - 100m depending on gear. very easy to kill wyverns or rune dragons afterwards

steps.text: spec transfer: Either splash the magic lvl or make tele tabs, string jewellery at lvl 80 to speed it up

steps.text: Blood rc alt: Takes around 60 hours to start rcing

steps.title: vyrewatch alt: Recommend making this after …
steps.text: vyrewatch alt: Recommend making this after you got 85 slayer if you only have 1 alt, Get 30 thieving and continue from line 24 on the vyre sheet
steps.note: Pickpocket the Chambers of Xeric thieving room (bring a lockpick), or steal Aldarin Villas chests (36-45); quests skip to 42.
